entry.name: fluid.bufampslice~
entry.description: Implements an amplitude-based slicer, with various customisable options and conditions to detect relative amplitude changes as onsets.

attributes.digest: Fast Envelope Ramp Down Length
attributes.description: The number of samples the relative envelope follower will take to reach the next value when falling. Typically, this will be faster than slowRampDown. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.description: How many frames should be processed.

attributes.name: offthreshold
attributes.digest: Off Threshold (dB)
